DRAWINGS
The drawings are objected to under 37 CFR 1.84(p)(3) because the reference
characters 202, 204 and 206 in FIG. 2 are less than 0.32 cm (1/8 inch) in
height. Corrected drawing sheets in compliance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) are
required in reply to this Office action. Any amended replacement drawing
sheet should include all of the figures appearing on the immediate prior
version of the sheet, even if only one figure is being amended.
